findings.evidence: `VectorBundle/Riemannian/Conformal.lean:86` `def rescale`; grep shows `yamabeRescale` only in this file, while `Analysis/PDE/Yamabe/ConformalLaplacian.lean:202`, `TotalScalarCurvature.lean:79` and `VolumeDensity/Conformal.lean:163` use `g.rescale (fun x ↦ u x ^ (4 / ((finrank ℝ E : ℝ) - 2)))`.
findings.fix: Delete `yamabeRescale` and `yamabeRescale_inner` and write `g.rescale (fun x ↦ u x ^ p) (hu.rpow_const_of_ne (fun x ↦ (hp x).ne') p) (fun x ↦ Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hp x) p)` with the existing `rescale_inner`.
findings.issue: `yamabeRescale` is `g.rescale (fun x ↦ u x ^ (4/(n-2)))` under a new name. No other file uses it; the existing Yamabe files call `rescale` directly.

findings.fix: Delete it and use `mem_conformalClass_iff_exists_rpow (div_ne_zero four_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hdim)))`.
findings.issue: `mem_conformalClass_iff_exists_yamabeRescale` is `mem_conformalClass_iff_exists_rpow` at `p = 4/(n-2)` with the equation flipped. Its proof is `rw [mem_conformalClass_iff_exists_rpow hp]` plus `eq_comm`.

findings.evidence: `VectorBundle/Riemannian/Conformal.lean:159` `theorem rescale_rpow_inj [∀ b, Nontrivial (E b)] {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0)`.
findings.fix: Delete it and use `g.rescale_rpow_inj hp (fun x ↦ (hup x).le) (fun x ↦ (hvp x).le)`.
findings.issue: `yamabeRescale_inj` is `rescale_rpow_inj` at `p = 4/(n-2)`, and its proof calls that lemma.

findings.evidence: Lines 120, 126, 133 and 198 of `VectorBundle/Riemannian/Conformal.lean` state these laws for arbitrary positive factors; the existing module docstring (lines 30-35) already covers the `4/(N-2)` case.
findings.fix: Delete them. Use `rescale_mem_conformalClass` (line 198), `rescale_one` (120) with `Real.one_rpow`, `rescale_rescale` (126) with `Real.mul_rpow`, and `rescale_inv_rescale` (133) with `Real.inv_rpow`.
findings.issue: `yamabeRescale_mem_conformalClass`, `yamabeRescale_one`, `yamabeRescale_yamabeRescale` and `yamabeRescale_yamabeRescale_inv` copy existing `rescale` laws at a fixed exponent.

findings.evidence: The proof uses only `mem_conformalClass_iff_exists_yamabeRescale` and `yamabeRescale_inj`, which are the two existing lemmas at a fixed `p`.
findings.fix: Restate it in `VectorBundle/Riemannian/Conformal.lean` as `mem_conformalClass_iff_existsUnique_rpow` for any `p ≠ 0` and `[∀ b, Nontrivial (E b)]`, proved from `mem_conformalClass_iff_exists_rpow` and `rescale_rpow_inj`.
findings.issue: `mem_conformalClass_iff_existsUnique_yamabeRescale` is the only new statement, and it is tied to the unused wrapper and a fixed exponent.
`Nontrivial (TangentSpace I x)` is built through `FiberBundle.trivializationAt ... linearEquivAt ... toEquiv.nontrivial`, which is unnecessary because `TangentSpace I x` is `E`.

summary: `yamabeRescale` is `rescale` with the exponent fixed at `4/(n-2)`, which no other file uses, and its two main theorems are `mem_conformalClass_iff_exists_rpow` and `rescale_rpow_inj` with that exponent filled in. The unit, composition, reciprocal and membership laws copy the existing `rescale` laws, so only the `∃!` form is new.
